description: This file defines the AsyncPipeline class, a utility for controlling the rate of asynchronous operations by maintaining a pipeline with a maximum capacity, providing back-pressure and stress-testing capabilities.

classes.name: AsyncPipeline
classes.description: A utility class to manage a pipeline of asynchronous tasks, controlling their execution rate for load testing or flow control.

methods.name: AsyncPipeline()
methods.description: Constructs an AsyncPipeline with default capacity.

methods.name: AsyncPipeline(int capacity)
methods.description: Constructs an AsyncPipeline with specified capacity.

methods.name: Add(Task task)
methods.description: Adds a single task to the pipeline.

methods.name: AddRange(IEnumerable<Task> tasks)
methods.description: Adds multiple tasks to the pipeline.

methods.name: AddRange<T>(IEnumerable<Task<T>> tasks)
methods.description: Adds multiple tasks of generic type to the pipeline.

methods.name: Wait()
methods.description: Blocks until all tasks in the pipeline are completed.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a task to the pipeline, managing capacity and blocking as necessary.

methods.name: AddRange
methods.description: Adds multiple tasks to the pipeline from a collection.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for all ongoing tasks to complete, blocking the calling thread.
